name: BLS Public Data API
update_frequency: Monthly and quarterly, depending on series
known_limitations: BLS labor and price series are authoritative for published series, but they do not explain project-level workforce bottlenecks without occupation, geography, employer, and training-pipeline evidence.
automation_notes: Use selected labor, wage, price, productivity, and industry series as context for workforce and cost constraints.
notes: Useful for separating labor-market evidence from anecdotal workforce claims.
